title: Yemen's separatist leader al-Zubaidi flees ahead of talks, Saudi-led coalition says
summary: The leader ​of Yemen's separatist Southern Transitional Council (STC), Aidarous al-Zubaidi, fled to an unknown destination on Wednesday, after skipping an airplane flight to Riyadh for talks to tackle a crisis that caused a major feud between Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
contentText: Yemen's separatist leader Aidarous al-Zubaidi "continues his duties from Aden", the Southern Transitional Council (STC) said Wednesday after the Saudi-led coalition in the country accused him of skipping a flight to Riyadh for talks. A council fighting against Yemen’s Houthi rebels earlier said it had expelled al-Zubaidi and charged him with treason.
